StackType.rationale: ShrinkPower.cs:26-36 is the only DYNAMIC StackType among the 134 ported powers: Counter while finite, Single once IsInfinite (Amount < 0). The sim models no StackType. Inert here: the only non-presentation reader is GetTypeForAmount, and at a negative amount StackType is Single so the Counter&&AllowNegative arm cannot fire while the !AllowNegative&&Debuff arm is excluded by AllowNegative, leaving Type == Debuff -- the same answer the sim's static attribute gives. Executed: `py audit/tools/power_census.py typing` shows shrink with neither arm set.

AllowNegative.issue: ShrinkPower.cs:38 declares `AllowNegative => true`; the sim's ShrinkPower never sets allow_negative, so it inherits False from Power (powers.py:47). That changes ShouldRemoveDueToAmount (PowerModel.cs:478-489): C# removes an AllowNegative power only at EXACTLY 0 and lets it sit negative, while the sim's stacking branch removes it at any amount < 0 (cmds.py:317-319). EXECUTED: applying Shrink -1 twice gives the sim Shrink(-1) then None, where the game keeps Shrink(-2) -- and a negative Shrink is C#'s INFINITE-duration encoding (ShrinkPower.cs:40 `IsInfinite => Amount < 0`), so the sim loses a permanent debuff outright. DORMANT: the only ported non-potion source is Shrinker Beetle's SHRINKER move at -1 (monsters/overgrowth/shrinker_beetle.py:40) and its move machine plays SHRINKER exactly once (_TRANSITIONS at shrinker_beetle.py:13 never returns to it), with one beetle per ported encounter. Named trigger: any second negative-amount Shrink source -- a two-beetle encounter, or a repeat of the SHRINKER move. Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterApplied.rationale: ShrinkPower.cs:48-64 is presentation: ScaleTo(0.5f) on the creature node (or Vantom.ScaleTo) plus filling the ApplierName StringVar for the tooltip.

AfterRemoved.rationale: ShrinkPower.cs:66-77 is the matching ScaleTo(1f) presentation undo.

AfterSideTurnEnd.issue: Two divergences in one hook. (a) The `!IsInfinite` guard (ShrinkPower.cs:81, i.e. Amount >= 0) is spelled `self.amount > 0` on both sim legs (powers.py:1390,1394); those agree only because Amount == 0 is unreachable (ShouldRemoveDueToAmount removes at exactly 0), so this half is equivalent rather than identical. (b) The SLOT is wrong on the player leg: AbstractModel.AfterSideTurnEnd is dispatched by Hook.AfterTurnEnd (Hook.cs:1267-1292), which CombatManager calls at :1307 for the player side -- AFTER the turn-end card effects and the hand flush. The sim's on_player_turn_end is Hook.BeforeTurnEnd (combat.py:654, before both), and the sim's actual AfterTurnEnd slot is after_player_turn_end (combat.py:665). So a player-held Shrink ticks one slot early. DORMANT: Shrink's tick has no interaction with the flush or with turn-end card effects, and the ported source applies Shrink at -1 (infinite), where neither leg ticks at all. Named trigger: a positive-amount non-potion Shrink source together with a turn-end card effect that reads the damage multiplier. Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterDeath.issue: The `wasRemovalPrevented` guard is missing. ShrinkPower.cs:87-93 removes Shrink only when `!wasRemovalPrevented && creature == base.Applier`; the sim tests only `creature is self.applier` (powers.py:1398). A prevented removal (a death whose corpse the combat keeps) therefore drops Shrink in the sim and keeps it in the game. The sim's on_death carries no wasRemovalPrevented argument at all (hooks.py:574-580), so this cannot be fixed inside the power. DORMANT: the sim's one retained-corpse mechanism is ReattachPower's Decimillipede (powers.py:2338-2341) and no Decimillipede segment applies Shrink. Named trigger: any Shrink applier whose death is removal-prevented. Third-file citations, not hashed here.

ModifyDamageMultiplicative.rationale: STALE as filed. RE-EXECUTED 2026-07-30: the record's premise -- 'the sim multiplies the factors together in float and applies the product once ... Shrink x0.7 with Vulnerable x1.5 on a 20-damage attack gives the sim 20 and the game 21' -- referenced hook_dispatch gap G9, which per binding rule 3 this entry does not re-argue. That mechanism has since moved: `hook_dispatch`'s guard G9 no longer exists as a distinct entry (grep for `G9` in `audit/records/seam/hook_dispatch.json` returns nothing), and the actual owning record, `audit/records/seam/damage_pipeline.json` guard N3, is now `faithful` ('Closed 2026-07-27: hooks.modify_damage_multiplicative is now a CHAIN, not a product -- it folds each listener's factor into the running amount and returns it, exactly as ModifyDamageInternal does ... The recorded witness now agrees: Shrink (x0.7) plus Vulnerable (x1.5) on a 20-damage powered attack gives 20*1.5 = 30, 30*0.7 = 21'). EXECUTED here independently rather than inherited (`.superpowers/sdd/unlabelled/probes/power-2-shrink-mult.py`, PYTHONPATH=repo root): Shrink(1) on the player, Vulnerable(1) on the enemy, `DamageCmd.deal(hooks, enemy, 20, dealer=player, card=strike)` returns **21**, matching the game and refuting the '20' the stale entry claimed. The 0.7 literal is still not a binary-exact float (`ShrinkPower.cs:105` computes it in `decimal`, powers.py:1386 -- now :1667 -- uses the Python float `0.7`), so the underlying non-dyadic-constant OBSERVATION in the entry's title remains true as a code fact, but it produces no observable divergence: the running-chain fold now matches C#'s arithmetic to the point DamageCmd's final int rounding lands on the same integer in the executed case, and rule 3 binds this hook's verdict to N3's now-faithful aggregation mechanism. WAS: `gap`, citing the parallel-product bug that N3's 2026-07-27 fix already closed.

guards.rationale: Enforced by DamageCmd.deal's is_powered_attack gate (cmds.py:56-58); the power's own `card is not None and not card.is_unpowered` (powers.py:1385) is the redundant restatement. See the strength record's matching guard.
The sim's two legs self-filter to the owner instead: `player is self.owner` (powers.py:1390) and `self.owner.side == 'enemy'` (powers.py:1394).
